_comment: Copy to data/config.json, or just run `node cc.mjs setup`. Secrets are better set as environment variables (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GRANOLA_API_KEY, MONDAY_API_TOKEN) — those override this file, so no key needs to live on disk.

identity._comment: How the extractor decides what was addressed to you, and whose meeting commitments are yours.
identity.name: Your Name

outlook._comment: Local Outlook desktop over COM. No app registration, no tokens. Classic Outlook only — the new Outlook for Windows dropped COM.

calendar._comment: Same COM surface. Teams meetings appear here, so no browser automation is needed for them.

granola._comment: Run `node cc.mjs granola-key grn_...`. includeTranscripts null = auto (on only when AI extraction is enabled).

monday._comment: Read-only. Set MONDAY_API_TOKEN in the environment instead of writing it here.

teams._comment: Not implemented. Would need a signed-in Playwright profile plus confirmation that automated browser access is permitted by your organisation.

ai._comment: Optional. Without a key, deterministic rule-based extraction runs instead — no network required.

vault._comment: One-way Markdown export for Obsidian. Regenerated every run; safe to delete.
